intro: The classic sights and Kelly's personal picks. Almost everything is a ~10-min walk from the main square.

kellysPicks.title: ⭐ Kelly's Picks
kellysPicks.blurb: Lead with these — they're the personal heart of the page.

places.name: Bistro Bastardo
places.blurb: Matthijs' favourite Mexican. On nám. Svobody.

places.name: Klárabára Winecafé
places.blurb: Kelly's favourite wine bar; lovely Moravian wines, owners pick for you. (Closed Sun.)

places.name: La Famiglia
places.blurb: Mum & Dad's favourite Italian.

places.name: William Thomas Artisan Bakery
places.blurb: Best croissant in Brno (go in the morning before they sell out).

places.name: Ještě jednu
places.blurb: Best ice cream. Yes, Niall, this one's for you. Artisan gelato, seasonal flavours, gloriously erratic opening hours.

places.name: The Bar That Doesn't Exist
places.blurb: Best cocktails.

places.name: Queen's Pub
places.blurb: For a spot of darts (and bait to lure Brit & Phil out). Live music, Guinness.

places.name: Pivovarský dům Poupě
places.blurb: Your brother's favourite, for the tabletop curling. Central brewpub on Dominikánská with its own beers. (Closed Sun.)

moreSpots.title: More good spots
moreSpots.blurb: Secondary to Kelly's Picks — for guests who want extra options.

places.name: Monogram Espresso Bar
places.blurb: The city's flagship specialty bar, by the station. (Closed Sun.)

places.name: But First Coffee
places.blurb: Cosy, world-map magnet wall, opens 7am. (Weekdays only.)

places.name: Pikolo Espresso Bar
places.blurb: Tiny stylish gem, superb oat-milk coffee. Seats ~6.

places.name: KIMONO coffee
places.blurb: Corner spot, one of Brno's best terraces, lovely desserts.

places.name: Vittorio
places.blurb: Polished Mediterranean/Italian; the spot for a proper nice dinner. (Closed Sun.)

places.name: Lokál U Caipla
places.blurb: Classic Czech done well, tank Pilsner, great value. Reserve.

places.name: Pivnice U Čápa
places.blurb: Hearty Czech pub near Veveří; svíčková, pork knuckle. Good for family.

places.name: Nok Nok
places.blurb: Modern, varied, English menu; easy middle-ground for a mixed group.

places.name: Stopkova Plzeňská Pivnice
places.blurb: Iconic central beer hall; roast duck, Pilsner. (Touristy but reliable.)

places.name: Super Panda Circus
places.blurb: Immersive speakeasy, no menu, ring the bell. Reserve.

places.name: Satin Bar & Café
places.blurb: Intimate, bartender's-choice. (Thu–Sat.)

places.name: Whiskáč na Jakubáku
places.blurb: Whisky bar with Brno-themed cocktails (same passage as Queen's Pub).
